mandatory_escalation_signals: node assumptions contradicted by current main
same actor would generate and independently approve its own result
suspected cheating cannot be disproved with retained evidence
semantic conflict with another active node
required migration affects an undeclared runtime path
protected branch, production, spending, or legal authority is required

tier_rules.T0: No semantic design choice; deterministic transformation or inspection only.
tier_rules.T1: One bounded component, stable interface, low blast radius, direct tests.
tier_rules.T2: Several files or one moderate design decision; reversible and locally testable.
tier_rules.T3: Cross-cutting runtime behavior, concurrency, security, or compatibility migration.
tier_rules.T4: Canonical kernel, authority, anti-cheating, promotion, or irreversible/broad architecture.
